title: Workspace: running programs
summary: ws~run(program, args...) is protected and judged as run:PROGRAM against the workspace path. Programs run through oorexx_process dev2 (argv, no shell, timeout); output goes to .newshell/runs/NNN-program.out/.err; the RunResult has exitCode, killedBy, output, errorPoint. Path arguments to run, and every list/tail/remove path, must stay inside the workspace and not pass a link. Look-only: ws~list(dir), ws~tail(file, n). ws~remove(file) is protected.
authority: built and tested (architecture Tom Dyer; coding and writing Claude (Opus 5.5), 2026-11-24)
invariants: A program is allowed by name per workspace: allow llm Workspace run:make /tmp
procedure: Add programs to the policy one by one; run:./* means any program inside the workspace
